coordinateSystem: Pixel coordinates, top-left origin; rectangle right/bottom exclusive; anchors absolute in source sheet.
rendering: Use one common scale per character for all poses. Translate each crop relative to its anchor; do not stretch individual crops to fill the destination. These are irregular inspected regions, not a uniform UV grid.

atlases.movement: Runtime rolls stable frame0 continuously around its reviewed body circle; distance per revolution equals body circumference. Frames1..7 document authored rotation poses; non-walk states8..23 remain atlas poses.

atlases.anchorMeaning: Visual horizontal center and lower body/foot baseline from alpha >=96, manually reviewed in contact sheet.
